description: S57 T9 (VG19): the agent's merge-rule door — mergerule.proposeTighten files an INERT merge_rule proposal for the caller's OWN component, the FULL rule beside the reason (a rule is proposed whole — a half-rule could hide a loosening in the fields it does not name). The wire speaks the schema's field names, the stored payload speaks the store's own Go names — the arm is the one translation; the componentId in the rule is the stamp, never a param (OL3). At create the shared validator re-runs the desk's half and the store's half, mergerule.Tightens field by field against the component's EFFECTIVE rule (the baseline when it has no row) — every field here tightens or is neutral, which is the only direction a merge_rule proposal may go. The answer is the stored inert row with the commit command and the fixed inertness note — the rule evaluates nothing until a person commits it (TD2/TD3).

params.reason: every reported check green is not enough on this component — name the checks that matter, need the local run on the PR head and the DoD all met before anything merges

payload.reason: every reported check green is not enough on this component — name the checks that matter, need the local run on the PR head and the DoD all met before anything merges

result.note: inert — nothing is enforced until a person commits this proposal at the socket's human door (TD2)
